title: Booking and Reversing Covered Days — Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
**Rule.** Covered days are counted by the midnight census: a day counts when the resident is in the center at midnight, so the day of admission counts and the day of discharge does not. A leave-of-absence day, when the resident is away at midnight without being admitted to a hospital, is neither a covered day nor a benefit day, and a day the resident is a hospital inpatient at midnight is not a SNF day either. Days are booked per calendar month of service, closed early at the last covered date, one row per band: benefit-period days 1 through the full-coverage day limit are the days 1 through 20 band and later days up to the benefit-period day limit are the days 21 through 100 band, so a month that crosses the boundary is booked as two rows. Days are booked only while the coverage is active, notice issued, under appeal or coverage ended. The first physician recertification is due by the initial recertification day and each later one within the recertification interval; days after a lapsed certification are provider liable, are reversed as uncertified days and are never billed to the resident. A booked day later found to be a leave-of-absence day, a hospital day, an uncertified day or a booking error is reversed against the booked-days entry it came from, never by editing that entry, and reversing days of the days 21 through 100 band reduces the coinsurance charged on them. A booked-days entry is reversed only for dates and a reason not already reversed on it.

This chapter of the Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage billing manual governs the booked-days entries of an episode.

### Statuses in which days are booked

| Coverage status | Days may be booked |
|---|---|
| Active, notice issued, under appeal, coverage ended | Yes |
| Pending verification, closed, not eligible | No — the rule lists only the four statuses above |

### Reversal reasons

| Day found to be | Reversal reason |
|---|---|
| Away at midnight on leave, not in hospital | Leave-of-absence day |
| A hospital inpatient at midnight | Hospital day |
| After a lapsed certification | Uncertified day |
| Booked in error | Booking error |

**Duplicate test.** A reversal is posted against a booked-days entry only for dates and a reason not already reversed on that entry, read from the system record of reversals naming it.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a month in which benefit days 15 through 23 fall is booked as two rows — days 15 to 20 in the days 1 through 20 band and days 21 to 23 in the days 21 through 100 band.
